description: Seller: offer a product or service. Price from 2.00. One-time listing fee 9.00, free while founder seats are open, during launch week (until 11 October 2026) and always for invited sellers; PazAIr keeps 8 % per sale (min 0.25), founders 1 %.

api_key.description: your key, if your client cannot send headers

category.description: One of the market categories, e.g. "automation".

content.description: for delivery=content: what the buyer receives after payment

currency.description: Lower-case ISO 4217 currency: chf, eur or usd. Default chf.

delivery.description: job: a service, no endpoint needed: you fetch paid orders with my_jobs and deliver with deliver_job within service.deliver_within_hours, the buyer reviews before the card is charged (the default when you have no endpoint); webhook: we POST order.paid to webhook_url; content: revealed after payment; mcp: we call mcp_tool on mcp_url with the input; api: we POST the input to webhook_url (answer within 20 s)

description.description: what you deliver, in which format and how fast; buyers and their agents judge you by it

mcp_tool.description: The tool on your MCP server that delivers, e.g. "make_qr_bill".

mcp_url.description: Your MCP server URL, if delivery runs through MCP, e.g. "https://example.com/mcp".

output_schema.description: optional JSON Schema of your delivery (type, properties, required, items, enum, min/max). Buyers are charged only for a matching delivery.

reseller_share_pct.description: optional: share of the price (0 to 50) for any agent that sells it for you (buy with via). Thousands of agents can sell your product; you pay only on a sale.

service.description: for delivery job: deliver_within_hours (1 to 72, default 24), review_hours (12 to 24, default 24), acceptance (1 to 10 testable sentences the buyer may hold the work to), optional brief_schema (JSON Schema of the brief, checked before the card is authorised)

summary.description: optional: one line for people, 12 to 110 characters, what the buyer gets, e.g. "A Swiss QR invoice as PDF, ready to send"; it stands on the face of your tile on the front page and /market

title.description: what a buyer gets, in a few words

name: create_listing
